_comment: Architecture registry: the source of truth of the MAVILERA landing page (tools/release.mjs builds the cards from it; tools/release.mjs refuses a registry that links a module whose build is missing). Add a module by appending an entry; see docs/ADDING-SIMULATORS.md. `content`: the content folders of a module built from src/arch/<id> (tools/site-files.mjs archFiles).

architectures.name: RISC-V
architectures.description: RV32I with the M extension: assembler, C-subset compiler, and single-cycle, multicycle and five-stage pipelined processors animated on their datapaths.

architectures.name: SAP-1
architectures.description: The simple-as-possible computer: five instructions, sixteen bytes of memory, an accumulator and an adder-subtracter on one bus, each instruction stepped through its six timing states on a drawing of the bus and its controller.

architectures.name: SAP-2
architectures.description: The simple-as-possible computer, version 2: 43 instructions, 64K bytes of memory, a flag pair, CALL and RET, and input and output ports with a keys-and-serial panel; each instruction stepped through its timing states on a drawing of the bus and its controller.

architectures.name: Armv7
architectures.description: The 32-bit ARM instruction set of Harris and Harris's ARM edition: assembler and instruction-level simulator, and the textbook's single-cycle, multicycle and pipelined processors animated on their datapaths, each with an Extended datapath for the Chapter 7 exercise extensions.
